# Luvia Creations

> Luvia Creations is an India-based handmade crochet brand offering colourful accessories, gifts, toys and decor.

Luvia Creations designs and handcrafts crochet products in India, with shipping across India. The website is the primary source for the current catalogue, prices and availability. Product and variant availability is shown as "In stock" or "Sold out"; contact Luvia to confirm delivery timing and customisation options.

## Brand

- Luvia Creations is a handmade crochet brand.
- Products are designed and handcrafted in India.
- The catalogue focuses on colourful handmade accessories, gifts, toys and decor.
- Product availability, colours and customisation options may vary by product.
- The website is the primary source for the current product catalogue and pricing.

## Official catalogue

- [Home / catalogue](https://luviacreations.com/): Browse current handmade crochet products, featured items and new arrivals.

## Contact

- [WhatsApp enquiries via the catalogue](https://luviacreations.com/): Use the website's WhatsApp contact or product enquiry buttons.
- [Orders email](mailto:orders@luviacreations.com): orders@luviacreations.com.
- [General enquiries email](mailto:hello@luviacreations.com): hello@luviacreations.com.
